companyDescription: CNS / ketamine · Preservative-free IV ketamine (NRX-100) awaiting ANDA approval Nov 10, plus an NDA path for suicidal depression, NRX-101, and a small HOPE ketamine-clinic network (Dura acquisition)
priceNote: Live $2.51 (+0.8%) at Oct 26, 2026 open. 52-week range $1.62-$5.055: off the low, but still half the high. Market cap ~$109M on 43.3M shares. The $38.50 consensus target (4 small-shop analysts) is far from price and should be read as a long-dated NDA thesis, not a 30-day target.
summary: NRX-100 (preservative-free IV ketamine) hits its GDUFA date on Nov 10, 2026. Every recent FDA interaction has been downgraded to Minor (amendment, labeling letter), and process validation is complete, so the binary is better-defined than most micro-cap PDUFAs. fda_decision is a Tier-2 LEADER in turbo feedback (+9.3pp median excess vs SPY vs +2.0pp overall, n=10). ⚠️ SURVIVAL: the Jun 30 10-Q carries going-concern language, with $26.7M cash against ~$2.2M/month operating burn and ongoing ATM use. This pick is in the top 5 anyway because the GDUFA event lands inside the runway and approval converts NRx from a pure story into a revenue-bearing ketamine supplier at a ~$109M valuation. The cost is a 2% max position and a dip-only entry. Scenario Base (+60%) runs far above the turbo lane's realized 30-day P75 (+12.2%; written-Base optimism bias +72.7pp). It assumes a 3-6 month horizon after approval, driven by a re-test of the $5 52-week high once ANDA revenue and the NDA path are re-priced. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50-80%.

catalysts.name: Benzethonium-chloride citizen petition
catalysts.description: NRx petitioned FDA to restrict ketamine containing the preservative benzethonium chloride. A favorable FDA response would make a preservative-free supplier the default, but the petition is contested and has no FDA deadline.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: going-concern doubt disclosed in the Jun 30, 2026 10-Q. Cash was $26.7M against ~$13.2M of H1 operating cash burn (~12 months of runway), and the company is actively funding through an ATM ($11.8M net in H1) plus an April $20.7M underwritten offering. More dilution right after approval is the base case, not a tail risk.
An ANDA approval is a generic ketamine product in a commoditized market. The large-value asset (NRX-100 NDA for suicidal depression, Fast Track) is a separate, later, and less certain filing.
The open CMC item (vial-to-syringe connector certification) is exactly the kind of issue that produced the Outlook Therapeutics CRL. 'Minor' classification is not approval.
The benzethonium-chloride petition campaign drew a contested NYT story and a public rebuttal. Reputational and regulatory friction could cut either way.
The $38.50 consensus comes from four small-shop analysts (BTIG at $10 is the realistic anchor). The target dispersion is a warning sign, not support.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A going-concern micro-cap is the most rate-sensitive profile in the market. Tighter financial conditions raise the cost and likelihood of the next ATM draw, and the 'approval then raise' pattern gets worse when risk appetite is thin.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — a hold on Oct 28 is priced, but hot CPI keeps another hike live. For a company funding itself through an ATM, a hawkish surprise directly raises dilution risk around the approval window.

postWin.note: PharmaTher (PHRM.CN) gained 148% in the six months after FDA approved its KETARx ketamine on Aug 8, 2025. That is a 6-month move, not a day-1 pop, and it is the only ketamine-approval precedent found. Treat it as an upper reference, not an expectation.

postLose.note: Average of two real 2025 small-cap CRLs: Capricor -33% in one day (Jul 11, 2025) and Outlook Therapeutics ~-80% after hours (Dec 31, 2025). With going-concern language, NRXP sits closer to the Outlook end if FDA asks for another cycle.

spotSizing.reason: 2% max. The fda_decision bucket is a Tier-2 LEADER in turbo feedback (+9.3pp median excess vs SPY vs +2.0pp lane-wide, n=10), but the survival flag and the lane's weak overall scoreboard (hitRate 4.9%, softHit 22%, n=41) both cap sizing at the bottom of the 2-5% band.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the fda_decision medianMAE (-18.4%, n=10). A break below ~$1.88 before Nov 10 suggests the market is pricing a financing or a CRL leak.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If FDA issues a CRL or the company announces a deeply discounted raise after approval, exit. Do not average down into going-concern dilution.

comparableCases.event: FDA approval of KETARx (ketamine) after two prior rejections
comparableCases.note: Closest product comparable: a micro-cap ketamine approval that re-rated the stock. The move took about six months, and the company then sold US rights for $25M+ in milestones. A ketamine approval can be worth more as a licensing asset than as an in-house launch.

comparableCases.note: Downside template for a cash-strapped small cap that misses an FDA date: CMC and inspection issues were cited, and the stock lost ~80% after hours. NRXP's open CMC item (the vial connector) is the analogous risk.
